messages:
Dana (Customer): Hey team — after the 2.1 rollout yesterday our service started getting invalid code from rw-code-coder-v2 when asking for JS functions. Several of our customers report compile errors and missing initialization steps. Filing here to coordinate. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/CS-9234 :exclamation:
Aisha (CS): thanks for flagging, Dana. can you paste one example prompt + the generated output you saw? also which model exactly (variant) and API params? :eyes:
Dana (Customer): sure, one of the failing prompts (we ask for a full Express.js server endpoint):
```
Prompt: "Write an express js endpoint that reads userId from req.body and returns user profile fetched from getUserProfile(userId). Include error handling and export the router."
API call: POST /v1/generate {"model":"rw-code-coder-v2","temperature":0.2,"max_tokens":512}
```
Generated output (truncated):
```
const express = require('express');
const router = express.Router();

router.post('/profile', async (req, res) => {
  const userId = req.body.userId
  try {
    const profile = await getUserProfile(userId)
    if (!profile) {
      return res.status(404).send({error: 'Not found'})
    }
    res.send(profile)
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err)
    res.status(500).send({error: 'Internal'})
  }
})

module.exports = router
```
Compiler error our CI shows when importing: `ReferenceError: getUserProfile is not defined` — previously the model would include a stub or require for the user service, e.g. `const {getUserProfile} = require('../services/user')`. Now it's missing. Also style drift: missing semicolons in several spots (our lint rules fail).
Aisha (CS): got it. any timestamps for when this started? did you pin to rw-code-coder-v2 or did the platform route you to it during the rollout?
Dana (Customer): started ~2024-11-14T09:42Z (around your canary window). We didn't pin; we use default model alias `code-latest`.
bot-deploy: Deploy notification — rw-code-coder-v2 rolled from canary to default alias at 2024-11-14T09:40Z by release/batch-2024-11-14 :gear:
Ben (SRE): tagging this — looks correlated. rollout timestamp matches. CS: we can pin the customer's org to rw-code-coder-v1 while eng investigates. Want me to do that now?
Evelyn (Solutions): yes please pin for now, that will buy time. Also, Dana — can you share a failing full file that reproduces the lint/compile errors? small repros are fine.
Dana (Customer): attaching a repo snippet: https://git.redwood.ai/repro/CS-9234 (private link). reproduction steps:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"code-latest","prompt":"<above>","temperature":0.2}'
2) save output to routes/profile.js
3) run `node --check routes/profile.js` and `npm run lint` -> fails.
Carlos (ML Eng): early hypothesis: the v2 rollout included a system prompt tweak that reduces invented imports/stubs in favor of minimal code. That could remove helper stubs like getUserProfile. Also we changed some tokenization/quantization kernels this rollout which may subtly change output formatting (semi-colon usage). Need to reproduce locally w/ exact model weights.
Carlos (ML Eng): can you paste the exact model identifier returned by the API when you call? alias vs model id matters.
Dana (Customer): response header X-Model-Used: rw-code-coder-v2-20241114-rc1
Aisha (CS): Carlos, Ben — priority: P1 for customer-facing regression. Suggest actions: 1) Pin customer to rw-code-coder-v1 alias (Ben). 2) ML to reproduce and diff outputs between v1 and v2 for that prompt (Carlos). 3) Check system prompt change log and rollout notes (Carlos/Aisha). 4) Notify product and schedule rollback or targeted config (Aisha).
Ben (SRE): I'm pinning org: customer_org_984 -> rw-code-coder-v1 (done). Confirmed they now get v1. Let me know when it's safe to unpin.
Carlos (ML Eng): running A/B on the prompt now. First quick diff: v1 includes `const {getUserProfile} = require('../services/user')` and semicolons. v2 omits the require and sometimes returns `async function getUserProfile(id) { /* ... */ }` in some seeds but not consistently. That explains ReferenceError. Also noticed v2 has a new temperature scheduling meta-param default of 0.0 -> 0.2 change for alias `code-latest` which could change stochastic behaviors.
Carlos (ML Eng): requesting logs for the exact seeds and top_p. Dana, can you confirm you were not setting seed or top_p?
Dana (Customer): correct, we used only temperature and max_tokens. top_p default.
Evelyn (Solutions): interim mitigation besides pinning: we can suggest customers add a short template in the prompt asking for "include all required imports and required helper stubs" — that'll reduce missing symbols quickly. But longer term we should fix the model behavior or adjust alias defaults.
Aisha (CS): product input: product-ops — any change in alias defaults during release? @product-ops
Aisha (CS): Carlos — can you run regression tests across our internal prompt set (esp. full-service generators) and quantify % of outputs that are missing imports or cause lint failures between v1 and v2? we need a metric to decide rollback vs config tweak.
Carlos (ML Eng): on it. starting run now. ETA ~45m. will post diffs and several examples.
Ben (SRE): logged incident INC-2024-11-14-CS9234, set severity P2 (escalated to P1 if more customers). pinned routing rule created.
Dana (Customer): appreciate the fast action. We'll validate the pinned behavior and report if we're green.
Carlos (ML Eng): preliminary numbers: across 200 prompt samples that previously passed lint in v1, about 12% now produce missing-import errors and ~18% have style-rule violations (semicolons, spacing). Not catastrophic but unacceptable for company's codegen SLA. Attaching sample diffs in a follow-up message.
Aisha (CS): thanks. action items: - Carlos: finish regression and attach diff CSV - Product: decide rollback policy or alias config (Aisha to loop in) - Ben: keep pin in place until eng says safe - Evelyn: prepare messaging to impacted customers and mitigation docs (prompt templates)
bot-deploy: Rollout monitor: Canary health check flagged increased lint failures at ~09:38Z and auto-promote threshold bypassed due to manual override.
Aisha (CS): OK team, I'll open a cross-functional warp room if Carlos's regression confirms >10% break. tagging leads: @eng-ml @product-ops @sre.
Dana (Customer): update — after pin our CI passes again. We'll wait for your follow-up before unpinning. Thanks everyone. :heart:
